title: Final Answer (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the energy correction when a is much smaller than sqrt(hbar/mω).

title: Final Answer (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the energy correction when a is much larger than sqrt(hbar/mω).

title: Integral Evaluation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly evaluate the integral involving the ground state wave function and the perturbation potential.

title: Perturbation Theory Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply first-order perturbation theory to find the energy correction.

title: Limit Cases Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The student should discuss the implications of the limits a << sqrt(hbar/mω and a >> sqrt(hbar/mω).

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the expressions for energy corrections.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all terms in the final expressions have consistent units.
